metadataReview.note: Reviewed location and date: the fortified Pukekohe East Presbyterian Church is the documented site of the attack. DOC, the Ministry for Culture and Heritage and Presbyterian archives all identify the attack as 14 September 1863. Start is corrected from 13 to 14 September; the existing end on 14 September is retained. The point locates the surviving church, not a township center or a conjectured grave.

metadataReview.coordinateBasis: Heritage New Zealand List 483 publishes the Pukekohe East Presbyterian Church map location in its page data: latitude -37.18860488232277, longitude 174.94613028083916. Rounded to four decimal places. DOC p.31 identifies the same church and surviving stockade remains as site R12/741; the point represents the fortified church, not its entire surrounding engagement area. No surveyed historical error radius is published.
